title: Ensuring Preschools Remain a Safe Environment and Preventing Cases of Violence by Staff against Any Child
what_it_is: Ensuring Preschools Remain a Safe Environment and Preventing Cases of Violence by Staff against Any Child

sections.label: Preschool safety requirements
sections.summary: The Early Childhood Development Centres Act and Regulations require all preschools to adhere to safety requirements and ensure enrolled children's safety and well-being.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Under the Early Childhood Development Centres Act and Regulations, all preschools are required to adhere to safety requirements and ensure the safety and well-being of enrolled children.

sections.label: Penalties for child mismanagement
sections.summary: Preschools with inadequate child management measures may face warning letters, financial penalties, revoked or shortened licences, and must report alleged mismanagement to ECDA within 24 hours.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Preschools found to have inadequate child management measures in place may be issued warning letters, subjected to financial penalties, have their licence revoked or licence tenure shortened.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In the event of alleged child mismanagement, preschools are required to report the incident to ECDA within 24 hours.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Ms Sun Xueling) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For serious cases, such as where there appears to be clear intent to harm the child, the case will be referred to the Police for criminal investigation.

sections.label: Staff suspended and terminated
sections.summary: The preschool suspended the staff in December 2019 and terminated her in January 2020, issued a warning letter, and she cannot work in preschools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: The first point about the case that she highlighted; the case is before the Courts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: I would just like to assure the Member that while the investigations were ongoing, that the preschool had suspended the staff in December 2019 and then terminated her employment in January 2020.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: There was also a warning letter issued to the staff for child mismanagement.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Subsequently, she is not allowed to continue working in preschools.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
sentences.text: Indeed, when there are cases of alleged child mismanagement, the preschool is required to do what they can, including looking at CCTV footage, to be able to present the material to parents, as well as to the Police to aid them in their investigations.
